brand.name: Rolls-Royce
brand.tagline: British ultra-luxury carmaker, part of the BMW Group since 2003
brand.description: British maker of ultra-luxury cars, built at Goodwood, England, and a wholly owned BMW Group subsidiary since 2003. Cars are imported to India as completely built units and sold through dealer showrooms in New Delhi and Chennai. The current Indian range is the Ghost, Cullinan, Phantom and the all-electric Spectre.

models.name: Ghost

items: Eight-speed automatic gearbox with Satellite Aided Transmission (GPS-based gear selection)
Planar Suspension System with Upper Wishbone Damper and self-levelling air struts
Flagbearer camera system that reads the road ahead and prepares the suspension
Five-link rear axle with self-levelling air suspension
Self-closing rear coach doors with power assist
SPIRIT operating system with pillar-to-pillar glass fascia
Rear-seat entertainment supporting two streaming devices
Four-camera system with panoramic and helicopter views
Collision, cross-traffic, lane departure and lane change warnings
Duality Twill bamboo-rayon seat fabric option
Grey Stained Ash open-pore wood veneer

highlights: Sold in India as Ghost Series II, Ghost Extended Series II and Black Badge Ghost Series II
6.75-litre twin-turbo V12 with all-wheel drive and all-wheel steering
Ghost Extended adds 170 mm of rear legroom via longer rear doors
Black Badge Ghost has 29 PS and 50 Nm more than the standard Ghost
SPIRIT operating system with Whispers app connectivity

variants.name: Ghost Extended Series II
features: Extended wheelbase with 170 mm more rear legroom
Rear champagne cooler with 6°C and 11°C modes

variants.name: Black Badge Ghost Series II
features: High-power V12: 600 PS / 900 Nm (29 PS and 50 Nm more than Ghost)
Lower-set Illuminated Grille with darkened chrome
Darkened brightwork and black Spirit of Ecstasy

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom page, updated 24 Nov 2026; before options). Power: Ghost 563 bhp/850 Nm per Rolls-Royce newsroom; Black Badge +29 PS/+50 Nm per the Ghost Series II press release. Boot 507 L from Rolls-Royce's Ghost (current generation) material. Top speed, 0-100, dimensions and fuel tank not found on reachable official pages (rolls-roycemotorcars.com timed out; used archived copies), so left null. Seats 4 or 5 depending on rear-seat configuration (check). India launch: Autocar Pro/Business Today report 5 Feb 2025; Autocar India's model page says 27 Dec 2024. Colours are a representative set; Bespoke paint is available. FTA: Rolls-Royce had not announced post-India-UK FTA price cuts at the time of checking.

models.name: Cullinan

items: All-wheel drive with front and rear steering

Bluetooth headphone pairing for rear passengers
SPIRIT operating system (first used in Spectre)
Whispers private members app (send destinations, track location, remote locking)
Tall daytime running lights and new air intakes
23-inch seven-spoke wheels milled from aluminium billet (first for Cullinan)

23-inch wheels offered on Cullinan for the first time
SPIRIT operating system with pillar-to-pillar glass fascia
Black Badge version rated at 600 PS and 900 Nm

variants.name: Black Badge Cullinan Series II
features: 'Low' button: Black Badge exhaust note, faster shifts, shorter brake pedal travel

Mirror-black chrome tailgate, bumper accents and exhausts

Brake callipers in Red, Black, Turchese, Mandarin or Forge Yellow

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom page, updated 17 Nov 2026; before options). India launch prices in Sept 2024 were ₹10.50 crore and ₹12.25 crore, so Autocar's lower current figures should be confirmed with a dealer. Black Badge 600 PS/900 Nm per Rolls-Royce newsroom; the standard 571 PS/850 Nm figure comes from Rolls-Royce's original Cullinan launch material (Series II keeps the same V12) — check. Dimensions, boot, fuel tank, top speed and 0-100 not found on reachable official pages, so left null. Seats 4 or 5 (Individual or Lounge seating). Colours are a representative set; Bespoke paint is available.

B Mode for increased brake recuperation

Two-door fastback body with coach doors

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom page, updated 17 Nov 2026; before options). Spectre launched in India 19 Jan 2024 at ₹7.50 crore; Black Badge Spectre in June 2025 at ₹9.50 crore. Spectre Series II was revealed globally in June 2026 (WLTP up to 628 km, 1,015 Nm); Autocar India lists it as upcoming for India, so this entry is the original Spectre — update when Series II launches. Dimensions, 0-100 and 430 kW/900 Nm are Rolls-Royce's preliminary figures from the 2022 unveiling. Range 530 km WLTP is the top of the official Black Badge Spectre range (493–530 km); the 2022 preliminary figure for Spectre was 520 km — check. India-UK FTA duty cuts exclude EVs for the first five years.
